wire.t: Tony Pollard went for 36.5 for Bill_Buttlicker on Sunday. Lawrence of a Labia leads Wild Goose Chase 135.18 to 107.34 heading into Monday night. The commish is allowed to enjoy this for exactly one day.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba scored 31.3 and NjigbaR Please! leads Lead Nagger 119.02 to 75.56 after Sunday. Joe Burrow (28.88) and Tee Higgins (26.8) were not enough for Pudge247.
Breece'sBurdenDeflowered sits at 160.90, the high score of the week, against MY DAD IS DEAD at 58.40. Zay Flowers (28.7) and Bucky Irving (24.0) did the heavy lifting for rtmcruise.
ChuckJ10 left Rhamondre Stevenson (23.5) and Caleb Douglas (22.0) on the Nothing to see here bench, 45.5 points total, and trails Stroud of Turin 105.02 to 113.52. Math is hard.
Monday night: Jacory Croskey-Merritt is ruled out against the 49ers, with Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler expected to see the work. Mike Evans is a game-time decision with a rib issue.
Drake Maye (28.44) carried Wild Goose Chase, but Br0phy's lineup still sits 27.84 behind Lawrence of a Labia and needs Monday night help.
Ivefallenandicantgetup trails Achane in the Membrane 79.40 to 95.60. krunkdd started Javonte Williams, still at 0.00, so Monday night is the only way out.
Bijan is your daddy trails Llamageddon 109.38 to 129.44 after Sunday. FatMikeR got 28.28 from Bo Nix and 27.1 from Trey McBride and still isn't winning.

stories.title: Tony Pollard dropped 36.5 and the commish is somehow winning
stories.dek: Sunday is in the books: Lawrence of a Labia leads Wild Goose Chase by 27.84, Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is at 160.90, and ChuckJ10 benched 45.5 points.
body: Bill_Buttlicker started Tony Pollard (36.5) and Jameson Williams (26.1) and Lawrence of a Labia is up 135.18 to 107.34 on Wild Goose Chase heading into Monday night. Yes, Bill_Buttlicker is writing about his own team being good. Enjoy it, because it's gonna get stripped by karma in Week 8.

The week's biggest swing is Breece'sBurdenDeflowered at 160.90 against MY DAD IS DEAD at 58.40, a +102.50 gap that would blow past the season record of +81.04 if it holds. rtmcruise got Zay Flowers (28.7), Bucky Irving (24.0) and Luther Burden III (23.7). OneSillyBannana is sitting on two zeros in the starting lineup, so the comeback needs a miracle.

ChuckJ10 benched Rhamondre Stevenson (23.5) and Caleb Douglas (22.0) and trails Stroud of Turin 105.02 to 113.52. That's 45.5 left on the pine. Last week he said he should've started Rhamondre. Reruns.

Still live Monday: Ivefallenandicantgetup trails Achane in the Membrane 79.40 to 95.60 with Javonte Williams at 0.00 so far for krunkdd, and Llamageddon leads Bijan is your daddy 129.44 to 109.38. NjigbaR Please! leads Lead Nagger 119.02 to 75.56. Final results and the By a C-Hair ruling post Tuesday.

stories.title: Two zeros are still sitting in starting lineups this morning
stories.dek: Lamar Jackson and DeVonta Smith have both been ruled out. krunkdd and Bill_Buttlicker both still have them in.
body: The Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson on Saturday afternoon, his third straight missed game with the ankle, and Tyler Huntley gets the start against Cincinnati. As of this morning, Lamar is still the starting QB for Ivefallenandicantgetup. Josh Allen is on bye. krunkdd's only other QB is Geno Smith, and the Jets play the Dolphins at 1. Swap him in or take a zero at the most important position on the field.

The Eagles ruled out DeVonta Smith (hamstring) on Saturday too, and he's still in the Lawrence of a Labia lineup. Philly doesn't play until Monday night, so Bill_Buttlicker has time. He also has a 45-point hole after Thursday and Jacoby Brissett at quarterback, so time might not be the issue.

Other starters to babysit today: Breece Hall (quad, questionable) for rtmcruise, Puka Nacua (calf, game-time decision at 4:25) for dcrabb, and Jordan Mason and Saquon Barkley (Monday) for OneSillyBannana. Byes this week are Buffalo, Jacksonville, the Chargers and Washington.
The line moved. Ivefallenandicantgetup opened as a 9-point favorite over Achane in the Membrane and is down to 1.5, and that's assuming krunkdd remembers to set his lineup.

stories.title: Defending champ is 1-5, broke, and down to his last healthy receiver
stories.dek: OneSillyBannana won the whole thing in 2025. Six weeks into his title defense, he's lost four straight, spent every FAAB dollar, and watched Davante Adams rupture a hamstring.
body: Ten months ago OneSillyBannana was holding the Addicks trophy after taking down MakeItRains in the final. Today MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-5 with the second-worst points total in the league and the worst all-play record of anybody (17-49). If you played every team every week, he'd beat roughly one a week.

The money is gone too. He spent all $200 of his FAAB budget, including $80 on T.J. Hockenson in Week 4. Hockenson gave him 1.7 points in his first start back, then went into the concussion protocol. He's been cleared and he's in the lineup again this week.

Then the injuries. Saquon Barkley's hamstring has turned his season into 23 points over four starts, and Davante Adams just ruptured his hamstring and is out 6-10 weeks. Saquon is expected back Monday night against Dallas, which might be the only good news this franchise has gotten since the parade.

Week 7 he gets Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, the luckiest 4-2 team in the league, and he's already down 43.60 to 10.90 after Thursday's Bears game. Saquon is questionable for Monday. If there was a game on the board for him, it's slipping.

stories.title: Achane in the Membrane is 1-5 and it's not his fault. It's God's.
stories.dek: MakeItRains has more points than five teams and the most points scored against him in the league. Give him Breece'sBurdenDeflowered's schedule and he's 5-1.
body: Last year MakeItRains made the championship game. This year he's lost three games while scoring 130-plus, including a 148.32 in Week 5 that ran straight into Wild Goose Chase's season-high 191.06. Nobody in the league has had more points dropped on them (824.16).

Run his real scores against Breece'sBurdenDeflowered's schedule and he's 5-1 and in first place. His all-play record is 32-34, basically a .500 team stuck at 1-5. Patrick Mahomes being the QB16 coming off ACL surgery isn't helping, but this one's mostly the schedule.

Week 7 he draws Ivefallenandicantgetup without Josh Allen, who's on bye, and without Lamar Jackson, who was ruled out Saturday. That's about as soft as Ivefallenandicantgetup gets. If the curse is real, Geno Smith throws for 400.

feature.title: Week 6: The newsletter guy finally shows up
body: Lawrence of a Labia put up 140.54, the top score of the week, and handed NjigbaR Please! its second loss. Christian McCaffrey had 30.7 and Trevor Lawrence added 27.3. It's the first time all year Bill_Buttlicker's team has looked like it deserved its record. Enjoy it. The all-play says 27-39.

The closest game of the season went to Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, 96.38 to 94.70 over Nothing to see here. Neither team cracked 100. ChuckJ10 now owns the season low, the biggest blowout loss, and the closest loss, a full set of misery in six weeks.

Llamageddon lost by 8.04 to Wild Goose Chase with Tre Tucker's 27.7 on the bench and Juwan Johnson's zero in the flex. Johnson played and just didn't catch anything. That's the sixth week in a row dcrabb has left a 20-pointer on the pine, and why a top-five roster is 2-4.

Bijan is your daddy started two zeros and lost to Achane in the Membrane by 11. One was bad luck (Bateman's shoulder). The other was Cam Skattebo, who the Giants benched and gave zero touches. Not every zero is a lineup mistake, but a $0 FAAB budget isn't helping anybody.

rankings.take: Most points in the league and the 191 bomb. Started Drake Maye this time and got 28.44 on Thursday. Growth.
Rookie owner, second-best team. Allen's on bye, Lamar was ruled out, and Lamar is still in the lineup as of Sunday morning. Geno Smith awaits.
Three rings and the WR1. Lost to the newsletter guy in Week 6, which should be a fireable offense.
Three straight wins, Isaiah Likely is the TE1, and the 2024 champ looks like himself again.
Top-five roster, bottom-four record. Leaves 23 points a week on the bench.
Average team, extraordinary quarterback drama. Got Stroud back. Cut Hurts the right way.
Last year's runner-up and the unluckiest man alive. Light a candle.
Still 10th in points. Down 47.44 to 2.00 after Thursday, with DeVonta Smith ruled out and still in the lineup. Still writes the newsletter.
Softest schedule in the league, no FAAB, and Mike Evans just hurt his Achilles.
Rookie owner hasn't spent a dollar on waivers. Got burned by two zeros in Week 6.
Last year's top seed. Benched Rhamondre for 23.5 on Thursday, a week after admitting he should've started Rhamondre.

teams.name: Wild Goose Chase
teams.w7: vs. Lawrence of a Labia · favored by 31.5
body: Br0phy went 5-9 as Skatt Men in his first season. Year two, he has the most points in the league (834.58), the season high (191.06), and the best all-play record (46-20). Christian Watson is the WR3. Drake Maye is the QB2. This is the best team in the league.

He picked the wrong quarterback in Week 4 and lost by 2.64 with Maye's 26.16 on the bench. Thursday he picked the right one: Maye 28.44, Swift 19.0, and a 47.44 to 2.00 lead on Lawrence of a Labia. He's still carrying Bryce Young and J.J. McCarthy in a one-QB league. Ja'Marr Chase has been quiet, but this roster wins anyway.

teams.name: Ivefallenandicantgetup
teams.w7: vs. Achane in the Membrane · favored by 1.5
inj: Lamar Jackson (ankle), OUT Week 7, still in the lineup
Josh Allen, James Cook III, Bhayshul Tuten and Dalton Kincaid on bye
body: krunkdd took over this seat this year and has the second-best team in the league. Josh Allen is the QB1, and he spent most of September with Lamar Jackson riding his bench as the most expensive backup in the league.

This week was supposed to be the payoff. Allen's on bye, and the Ravens ruled Lamar out Saturday for his third straight missed game. As of Sunday morning Lamar is still in the lineup and Geno Smith is on the bench. krunkdd needs to make one tap before 1 PM or start a zero against the most cursed team in fantasy football.

teams.name: NjigbaR Please!
body: The only three-time champion in Addicks history (2021, 2022, 2023). He's 4-2 with JSN as the runaway WR1 at 164.9 points.

He's not flawless. $125 on Mike Washington Jr. in Week 1, never started. Tyler Shough scored -0.16 in Week 5 and he still won that week, because of course he did. Losing to the newsletter guy in Week 6 was the low point of his season.

teams.name: Lead Nagger
body: Pudge247 won it all in 2024, went 5-9 last year, and is back on a three-game heater. Isaiah Likely is somehow the TE1 and Kenneth Walker III is the RB2.
He sat Sam Darnold's 27.66 in Week 3 and lost by 7.82, It's working anyway. Week 7 against the dynasty is the game of the week.

teams.name: Llamageddon
teams.w7: vs. Bijan is your daddy · favored by 13.5
body: dcrabb has the second-highest max points in the league (903.06) and has left 138.4 points on his bench, the most of anybody. He has Purdy and Goff and keeps guessing wrong between them. He had Tre Tucker (27.7) on the bench and Juwan Johnson (0.0) in the flex in a Week 6 loss by 8.
Seven seasons, zero finals. The roster can win this league. The guy setting the lineup has to let it.

teams.name: Stroud of Turin
teams.w7: vs. Nothing to see here · favored by 16.5
body: RedDevil904 named his 2022 team Circle-Jerk Kirk, so the Cousins thing isn't new. In Week 3 he dropped C.J. Stroud for Kirk Cousins. Then he traded Cousins and Jaylen Waddle to Achane in the Membrane to get Stroud back. Same QB, one less receiver, and the team's literally named after him.

To be fair, cutting Jalen Hurts was the right call. Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season with blood clots in his lungs. He also spent $190 of FAAB, the third-most in the league, chasing receivers.

teams.name: Achane in the Membrane
past: Gibbs Your Balls A Tug (2025 runner-up)
body: Last year's runner-up has the most points against in the league and three losses with 130-plus. Swap in Breece'sBurdenDeflowered's schedule and he's 5-1. Mahomes is the QB16 coming off ACL surgery, but Gibbs is the RB1 overall. The roster isn't the problem.
He just traded for Kirk Cousins and Jaylen Waddle. At 1-5 in a keeper league, he's at a fork: chase it, or sell Gibbs and set up 2027.

teams.name: Lawrence of a Labia
inj: DeVonta Smith (hamstring), OUT Monday, still in the lineup
DJ Moore and Trevor Lawrence, on bye
body: Most regular-season wins in league history (61) and zero titles. Lost the 2019 final, went 12-2 in 2021 and lost in the semis, finished third last year. The newsletter guy is the league's most decorated loser.

This year he's 4-2 with the 10th-most points, the luckiest team in the league by a mile. Week 7 he's starting Jacoby Brissett against the best team in the league, he's down 47.44 to 2.00 after Thursday, and DeVonta Smith was ruled out Saturday and is still in his lineup. Physician, set thy lineup.

teams.name: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered
teams.w7: vs. MY DAD IS DEAD · favored by 10.5
body: Three final appearances, three losses. The league's eternal bridesmaid is 4-2 behind the fewest points against in the league.

He spent $100 on Kalif Raymond and $61 on Braelon Allen and was broke by Week 4. Mike Evans is out and Breece Hall is questionable, but the Bears bailed him out Thursday: Luther Burden III and Colston Loveland put up 43.60 combined and he leads the defending champ by 32.70.

teams.name: Bijan is your daddy
body: FatMikeR is new this year and hasn't spent a dollar of FAAB. He's sitting on $200 while everyone else is broke. That's either a genius plan for the playoff push or he forgot the app has a waiver tab.

Week 6 he started Cam Skattebo, who the Giants benched with zero touches, and Rashod Bateman, who hurt his shoulder. Two zeros, lost by 11. Now Deebo's hamstring is out too. Time to spend some money, FatMikeR.

teams.name: Nothing to see here
body: ChuckJ10 won the very first Addicks in 2019 and was last year's top seed at 11-3 before losing in the semis. This year he has the fewest points in the league, the season low (63.02), the biggest blowout loss (81.04), and the closest loss (1.68).

Justin Jefferson and Malik Nabers are on this roster. Caleb Williams finally showed up Thursday with 22.12. Then Rhamondre Stevenson scored 23.5 on the bench, one week after ChuckJ10 admitted he should've started Rhamondre in a 1.68-point loss. He leads Stroud of Turin 29.92 to 0, so maybe it doesn't matter. It should, though.

teams.name: MY DAD IS DEAD
body: The defending champion. Went 12-2 in 2024, won it all in 2025, and is now 1-5 with the worst all-play record in the league.

He blew all $200 of FAAB, including $80 on Hockenson in Week 4, a guy he'd added and cut in Week 1. Adams is out 6-10 weeks, Saquon has 23 points in four starts, and two of his starters are in the concussion protocol. The title defense is over. Selling Chris Olave for 2027 is the move.

krunkdd has reportedly set an alarm for 12:55 PM labeled 'LAMAR IS OUT' and then snoozed it four times.
Br0phy has been texting Drake Maye 'sorry about Week 4' every night at 2am. After Thursday, Maye finally texted back a thumbs-up.

RedDevil904 has drafted paperwork to rename his team 'Cousins of Turin,' deleted it, re-drafted it, and traded it back to himself.
rtmcruise has started a Luther Burden III fan club. Membership is one. The club's motto is 'it's in the team name, sort of.'
FatMikeR made five roster moves last week. The league office has asked him to confirm it was actually him and not a burglar who knows his phone passcode.

trades.why: krunkdd has four real running backs (Henry, Javonte, Cook, Tuten) and his WR room is Courtland Sutton and a pile of rookies. ChuckJ10 has two WR1s and refuses to start the RB he has. Give him a back he'll actually play.
Achane in the Membrane is 1-5 with one superstar and no depth. Two weekly starters for the RB1 fixes two lineup holes, and Pudge247 gets the best back in football for his playoff run.
dcrabb has receivers to burn and keeps benching Tucker anyway. Bill_Buttlicker has CMC, Pollard and Dobbins at RB and a DeVonta Smith who's out this week.
Br0phy is deep at RB with Swift, Hubbard and Aaron Jones. The defending champ has Adams out 6-10 weeks and Saquon questionable, so he needs a healthy back more than another receiver.

FatMikeR starts two tight ends (McBride and LaPorta) because his receivers keep getting hurt. Pudge247 has a Burrow stack to spare and an Isaiah Likely he can't trust forever. Everybody gets a normal lineup.

dstafford4254 decides the WR1 by 34 points has peaked and takes the newsletter guy's backup QB. The team is literally named after JSN. He'd have to rename it 'BrissettR Please!' and he's fine with that.
krunkdd panics about Lamar and sends the QB1 overall for Br0phy's third-string quarterback. Br0phy accepts, then starts Bryce Young anyway out of habit.
RedDevil904 trades Stroud for Cousins. Again. At this point it's not a trade, it's a custody arrangement.

trying: Lamar's out, Lamar's starting, Geno's on the bench. krunkdd has one job before 1 PM.
He opened the app. Five free-agent moves last week. FatMikeR stays on this list until one of them actually scores.
Yes, the newsletter guy. Down 45 after Thursday with a ruled-out DeVonta Smith in the lineup.

Up 32.70 on the defending champ before Sunday. Softest schedule in the league and now the Bears are doing his homework.
Dropped Stroud for Cousins, then traded two guys to get Stroud back. Down 29.92 to 0 to the worst offense in the league.

columnists.name: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner
columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from the press box, where he's been asked to leave twice. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columnists.name: Dick Fitzwell
columnists.bio: Former college linebacker who still talks like he's in the film room. Blunt, loud, and always one sentence away from calling you soft.

columnists.name: Oliver Klozoff
columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league once. Nobody knows how. Files his columns from a lawn chair and gives advice anyway.

columnists.name: Connie Lingus
columnists.bio: Has a spreadsheet for everything. None of her spreadsheets are correct, and she will defend every one of them.

columns.title: Klozoff's 5 Moves to Win Your League (Guaranteed)
columns.dek: I've been doing this a long time. Not well, but a long time.
body: 1. SELL JAXON SMITH-NJIGBA. dstafford4254, listen to me. He's the WR1 by 34 points. That's called a peak, and what comes after a peak? A valley. Trade him right now for two backup tight ends and a defense on bye. That's called diversifying your portfolio.
2. FatMikeR, DO NOT SPEND THAT $200 FAAB. That money is compounding. By Week 17 it could be worth $210, maybe $215. Your receivers are hurt? So is the economy. Hold the line.

3. Bench Josh Allen permanently. krunkdd, he's on bye this week and the Bills will survive without him, which proves he's replaceable. Lamar's right there. Start the hot hand. Lamar hasn't played in two weeks, which means he's fully rested and his hands are hot from not being used.

4. Lawrence of a Labia should start Jacoby Brissett every week from now on, even when Trevor Lawrence is back. Two quarterbacks named after the same thing? No, wait, that's not it. I don't remember why. Just do it.

5. Everybody pick up a kicker. I know this league doesn't have a kicker slot. That's exactly why nobody's doing it. Zig when they zag. Corner the market. When the commissioner adds a kicker slot in Week 14, you'll own all of them and I'll accept your thanks in the form of a venmo.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: The data says you should only start Bears
columns.dek: One Thursday night game. Eleven fantasy starters. A sample size I'm calling 'definitive.'
body: Thursday night gave us a clean experiment. Seven Bears were in starting lineups in this league: Caleb Williams (22.12), Luther Burden III (23.7), Colston Loveland (19.9), D'Andre Swift (19.0), Rome Odunze (10.9), the Bears defense (4.0) and Roschon Johnson (1.3). That's 100.92 points, or 14.42 per Bear.

Four Patriots started: Drake Maye (28.44), Hunter Henry (14.1), A.J. Brown (7.8) and the Patriots defense (2.0). That's 52.34, or 13.09 per Patriot. The Bears won the game 30-24. My model therefore concludes that a Bear is worth 1.33 more fantasy points than a Patriot, which, scaled across a nine-man lineup, is about 12 points a week. Start nine Bears. I don't care what position they play.

Now the bench. Four players from that game sat on benches in this league: Rhamondre Stevenson (23.5), DeMario Douglas (5.3), TreVeyon Henderson (4.3) and Kalif Raymond (0.28). That's 33.38 bench points, and 70.4% of it belongs to ChuckJ10. My model says ChuckJ10's bench is now the 13th team in this league, and it is undefeated.

Final note: rtmcruise started two Bears with 'Burden' energy and leads by 32.70. His team name contains the word 'Burden.' Luther Burden III scored 23.7. Correlation is causation if you believe hard enough. I've run it 10,000 times. It came out the same 10,000 times, because I didn't change anything.

columns.title: ChuckJ10 benched 45.5 points. I watched the tape.
columns.dek: Dick Fitzwell on why Nothing to see here keeps losing to the bench.
body: I played linebacker. We had a rule: if the guy is open, you don't leave him open. Rhamondre Stevenson scored 23.5 on ChuckJ10's bench. Caleb Douglas scored 22.0 on ChuckJ10's bench. That's 45.5 points, and Nothing to see here trails Stroud of Turin 105.02 to 113.52.
Last week ChuckJ10 told the league chat he should've started Rhamondre. Then he did it again. That's not bad luck, that's soft. You see the guy putting up numbers, you put him in. Simple.

Stroud of Turin isn't exactly dominating, either. RedDevil904 is up 8.50 and I wouldn't call that a lead I trust. This is a game decided by who's less soft, and right now it's a coin flip with a thumb on the scale.
Fix the lineup, ChuckJ10. Or stay at 2-4 and keep blaming the sun.

columns.title: A HUNDRED AND TWO POINTS. ONE HUNDRED AND TWO!
columns.dek: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner on a +102.50 gap that has no business existing.
body: BREECE'SBURDENDEFLOWERED IS AT 160.90 AND MY DAD IS DEAD IS AT 58.40! THAT'S A GAP OF 102.50 POINTS! I've been in press boxes for thirty years and I've seen drunker box scores, but not many!

rtmcruise got 28.7 out of Zay Flowers, 24.0 out of Bucky Irving, and 23.7 out of Luther Burden III! THREE GUYS! THREE GUYS DID THAT! And OneSillyBannana has two starters sitting on 0.0 and I want somebody to explain that to me, because I cannot! I WILL NOT!
I know Monday night is still coming and somebody could throw up some points. So what! YOU DON'T CLIMB OUT OF A HUNDRED-POINT HOLE WITH ONE GAME! THAT'S NOT A COMEBACK, THAT'S A RESCUE MISSION!
Pudge247, FatMikeR, krunkdd, you're all on notice! The Mouth sees everything! THE MOUTH SEES ALL!

exits.t: Scored 23.5 on the bench Thursday, one week after his manager admitted he should've started him. Sources say he's requested a trade to any roster where the guy setting the lineup reads his own group chat.
Signed for $100. Zero starts. Sources say he's asking why he was bought just to sit, and whether this is a fantasy team or a storage unit.
Cost $125 in Week 1 and hasn't started a game. Reportedly feels like the expensive throw pillow nobody's allowed to touch.
The WR3 in fantasy has reportedly asked why Br0phy needs three quarterbacks in a one-QB league. Br0phy finally started the right one Thursday. Watson's camp is cautiously optimistic.
Requested a trade after sitting on the bench for 27.7 points while his manager started a tight end who scored zero. Would settle for a manager who reads box scores.
The RB1 overall has reportedly asked team doctors whether the Achane in the Membrane curse is contagious. They didn't know. Nobody does.

facts: dstafford4254 won three straight titles (2021-2023). Nobody else has more than one.

commish.title: The Commissioner's Office
commish.dek: The two men who run this league, collect your money, and answer to no one.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.

rulings: Bill_Buttlicker scored 104.44. FatMikeR's 101.92 was closest, so Bijan is your daddy takes the pot.
